You will also lead special projects for Group Managers and Operations Officers as they arise throughout the year.
cond_0026.responsibilities:
Monitor and analyze budget-to-actual performance, identify variances, and determine corrective actions.
Deliver clear and concise financial presentations to management.
Collect, analyze, and interpret financial data to assess trends and drive recommendations.
Develop financial models to support forecasting, budgeting, and strategic planning.
Lead market research to assess the competitive landscape and identify opportunities or risks.
Execute ad-hoc special financial studies and analyses as required, and direct cross-functional projects that require financial expertise.
cond_0026.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or Business Administration, or equivalent years of experience
1-2 Years of business experience
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex financial information clearly and concisely
Analytical thinking and problem-solving ability within financial contexts
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Access
Preferred Requirements
Organizational skills to manage multiple projects with competing deadlines
Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment
Customer focus: prioritize customer needs and maintain a client-centered approach in financial analysis
